move: headline swings in from blurred 3D rotation, snaps sharp, spins out
how: Three huge blurred colour orbs (pink, blue, mint, filter blur(70px)) drift slowly on sine.inOut for the whole 2s behind a centred stack of headline, subline and a glass pill. The headline enters over the first 42% from rotationY -100, rotationX 25, z -300, scale 1.35, opacity 0 and filter blur(28px) to flat and sharp with expo.out; the subline follows at 9% from rotationY 80 / z -200 / blur(18px), and the pill fades up from y 20 / blur(10px) with power3.out at 19%. During the hold the whole wrap sways rotationY 6 / rotationX -3 with sine.inOut. From 77% the headline spins away to rotationY 90 with z -250 and blur(24px) (expo.in), the subline counter-rotates to -70 and the pill blurs out, leaving the drifting orbs.
adapt: Replace the headline, subline and pill strings and the three orb colours; adjust font size to the headline length. Keep the entry values (rotationY -100, blur 28px, expo.out over ~0.85s) and the exit to the opposite side; they give the spin its snap.
port: mount(el, shot) renders the three .orb divs and the .wrap stack, with perspective set on el; animate(el, shot, D) returns a gsap.timeline with the orb drifts as full-D sine tweens and the text tweens at 0, 0.09D, 0.19D, 0.4D and 0.77D. Selectors scoped to el.
caveats: three 500px orbs with filter blur(70px) plus blur on text are slow to render
backdrop-filter on the pill adds cost
